workflow.title: Before running Mac maintenance: match the utility to your macOS version
workflow.primaryIntent: Choose an OS-matched maintenance utility rather than blindly run cache cleanup for unexplained storage growth
outline: Identify the Mac's macOS version and processor before selecting an installer
Use the official version table, not an old download recommendation
Separate a targeted repair or parameter change from investigating recurring disk growth
Review intended changes and backups; do not equate cache size with safely recoverable space
Choose the tool for the actual task, with source-backed limits
workflow.distinctValue: OS-version selection and maintenance-versus-investigation decision, not a renamed comparison matrix
